patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Shopware and Square Online share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Comparison thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs. Choose Shopware only if your buying job matches “Symfony open-source commerce — Community Edition free (Fair Usage ~€1M GMV); Rise from ~$6” rather than Square Online's shape. Choose Square Online only if your buying job matches “Square ecosystem online store — Free $0/mo (higher online processing), Plus $49/location, ” rather than Shopware's shape. Workflow advantage: Shopware leans catalog-management, wholesale-b2b; Square Online leans omnichannel-retail. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Shopware and Square Online share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Shopware is Symfony open-source commerce — Community Edition free (Fair Usage ~€1M GMV); Rise from ~$660/mo; Evolve from €2400/mo; Beyond quote.; Square Online is Square ecosystem online store — Free $0/mo (higher online processing), Plus $49/location, Premium $149/location; 30-day trials on paid tiers.
- Company-size focus: Shopware (small-business, mid-market, enterprise) vs Square Online (solo, micro, small-business).
- Workflow coverage skew: Shopware-leaning catalog-management, wholesale-b2b vs Square Online-leaning omnichannel-retail.
- Researched limits: Shopware — Community Edition Fair Usage pushes paid plans above ~€1M GMV; Square Online — Best fit inside Square POS ecosystem — weaker as standalone SaaS platform vs Shopify.

Limitations — Shopware: Community Edition Fair Usage pushes paid plans above ~€1M GMV; Rise commercial floor is high versus WooCommerce core + hosting; Square Online: Best fit inside Square POS ecosystem — weaker as standalone SaaS platform vs Shopify; Free tier online processing spread (3.3% + 30¢) can exceed paid-tier savings at volume.

Poor-fit cases: Shopware is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Community Edition Fair Usage pushes paid plans above ~€1M GMV · Square Online is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Best fit inside Square POS ecosystem — weaker as standalone SaaS platform vs Shopify · Avoid Shopware if you actually need Square Online's motion (Square ecosystem online store — Free $0/mo (higher online processing), Plus $49/)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
